field.name: in_corp_tax_rate
field.comment: IN corporate income tax rate: 4.9% flat rate (2025, Indiana Code § 6-3-2-1)

field.name: in_apportionment_formula
field.comment: IN uses single-sales factor apportionment (100% sales)

field.name: in_economic_nexus_threshold
field.comment: IN economic nexus gross receipts threshold: $100,000 (transaction threshold removed Jan 1, 2024)

field.name: in_transaction_threshold
field.comment: IN transaction threshold eliminated as of January 1, 2024 (previously 200)

field.name: in_state_additions
field.comment: IN additions to federal taxable income (out-of-state municipal bond interest acquired after 12/31/2011, certain expenses, etc.)

field.name: in_state_subtractions
field.comment: IN subtractions from federal taxable income (IN municipal bond interest, state income taxes, state NOL, etc.)

field.name: in_state_credits
field.comment: IN tax credits (economic development, R&D, headquarters relocation, neighborhood assistance, etc.)

field.name: in_taxable_income
field.comment: IN taxable income after apportionment and modifications

field.name: in_has_nexus
field.comment: Whether corporation has nexus with Indiana
